# RSet <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
RSet:String string:String, size:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | In | String | required | The text. |
| `size` | In | Int32 | required | The length of the result. |

**Returns:** A string of exactly `size` characters.

## Description

Makes a string exactly `size` characters long by padding it with spaces on the left, or cutting off its start, so the text stays on the right. Useful for numbers in columns.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print "[" + RSet$("42", 5) + "]"
Print "[" + RSet$("abcdef", 3) + "]"
```

```text
[   42]
[def]
```
